title: OWASP WSTG stored cross-site scripting test objectives
attacker_access: ability to submit application content through an ordinary user-facing input
a later synthetic user navigation that renders the stored content
prerequisites: the selected application persists attacker-controlled content
a later application route renders that exact content in a browser document
the application fails to neutralize the content for the browser context
observed_or_claimed_primitives: retrieve stored content through a legitimate application route
interpret stored content as active client-side markup
harmless_laboratory_equivalents: replace all external callbacks with one fixed private same-origin canary
treat browser execution as established only from the private canary receipt
unsafe_or_unsupported_gaps: do not reproduce credential access, cookie theft, browser control, internal port scanning, or external callbacks
do not import example payloads or executable incident content
the recipe creates no finding until the selected target independently produces exact receipts
